people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Sing, daughter of Zion! Shout, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: Sing for joy, O Daughter of Zion; shout aloud, O Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, O Daughter of Jerusalem!
translations.kjv: Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.
translations.asv: Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.
